profile.headline: Associate Software Engineer at Red Hat

positions.title: Full-Stack Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Standardized the features of a website by 95% and optimized it with the use of React Native. 
• Led the team of five members in order to develop the RESTful Web Services with MVC Framework and built responsive UI.    
• Designed the web pages using HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, jQuery and also used Node JS for server-side scripting.

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description:
• Spearheaded the end-to-end development of a customer-facing web application, employing Java and Spring Boot for the backend and JavaScript for the frontend.
• Developed RESTful APIs, enabling seamless communication between the frontend and backend systems.
• Collaborated with UI/UX designers to create responsive and user-friendly interfaces, resulting in a 20%
increase in user engagement.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Intern
positions.description:
• Managed tasks within an Agile framework, cleared Sprinted tasks and controlled JIRA workflows. 
• Conceptualized and tested native Android applications, including UI, core functionality, and third-party SDKs. 
• Deployed a beta version of the Student Edge app, which helped to identify bugs, user experience, and functionality issues.

projects.title: IEX Stock Watch
projects.description:
Technologies: -  ReactJS, JSX, JSON, CSS3, IEX Stream API, AWS Amplify. 
• Built a responsive UI using ReactJS that fetches real-time stock data from IEX Stream API and displays the stock rate, graphical visualization of respective stock, and other principal information. 
• Followed Layered architectural pattern and deployed the application with the help of the AWS Amplify console.

projects.title: Online Meal Delivery System
projects.description:
Technologies: - Java, J2EE, Python, JavaScript, HTML5, AJAX, jQuery, Google Maps API, Zomato API, MySQL, MongoDB.  
• Retrieved data from REST APIs using Python and JavaScript, likewise designed Responsive UI using Bootstrap. 
• Successfully developed a feature that generates ETA for meal delivery with the help of Google Maps API.
